questions.why: PGF2α causes myometrial hypercontractility and ischaemia, which is why NSAIDs relieve it.

questions.q: The main lung volumes that add up to the vital capacity are:
opts: tidal volume + inspiratory reserve volume only
inspiratory reserve volume + tidal volume + expiratory reserve volume
questions.why: Vital capacity is the maximum air that can be expired after a maximal inspiration: IRV + TV + ERV (about 4.5–4.8 L).

questions.q: Tablets used in homoeopathy are made of:
questions.why: Homoeopathic tablets are pressed from lactose; globules and pilules are made of cane sugar.

questions.q: A Smith's fracture is a fracture of the distal radius with:
opts: volar (anterior) displacement of the distal fragment
dorsal displacement of the distal fragment
fracture of the ulnar styloid only
questions.why: Smith's fracture is the 'reversed Colles'', caused by a fall on the back of the flexed wrist.

questions.q: Which remedy is inimical to Rhus toxicodendron?
questions.why: Apis and Rhus tox are inimical and should not follow each other. Bryonia is complementary to Rhus tox.
